steps.label: Classical EC relies on reading a bit non-destructively

steps.label: A qubit's value lives in amplitudes α and β

steps.label: A classical bit has exactly one way to be wrong
A qubit can be corrupted by a continuum of errors

steps.label: Yet only a discrete set of error types needs correcting
steps.sub: Bit flips, phase flips, and combinations of the two
